accepted_scope: The frozen kernel-only delivery: complete typed-source execution, independent Real/native coordinate results, actual Tensor pointer-fed input memory, original signed metadata, complete tagged-memory output/frame and program-order coverage. Primitive and compiler model boundaries remain explicit.

frozen_integrity.receipt_content_checks: Each available receipt records exit_code 0, matches the current source hash, and matches every listed artifact hash. All 21 required module receipts satisfy those checks.

independent_import_closure.method: Nested-comment-aware static traversal from Correct.lean, FPEquiv.lean and Proofs/KernelAudit.lean, independently of the delivery freezer. Both recorded LEAN_PATH variants were searched for each first existing repository .olean.
independent_import_closure.external_scope: External import names are recorded; this review did not rebuild or recursively re-audit the external dependency trees.

source_execution.quotation_review: KernelSource.lean retains the complete JIT body: program IDs, signed packed metadata loads, scalar/tensor offsets, early return, split/interleaved paths, conjugation, fallback constants, masks and every store. The explicit initial seqlen assignment represents the function argument environment; the packed branch shadows it as in Python.
source_execution.metadata_widths: Four source declarations cover signed int32/int64 cumulative lengths and offsets. Their exact Int carrier equality is paired with original byte-width decoding and checked finite signed bounds; it is not a runtime conversion or copy.
source_execution.precision: Payload tags remain FP32. The structural .real carrier is an opaque compute carrier, independently instantiated with exact Real arithmetic or raw-word provenance nodes.
source_execution.constructed_execution: TypedSetup.setup, indices, TypedLoads.loads and TypedStores.finish construct successful runs of slices extracted from the same quotation. TypedControl preserves the actual branches. TypedExecution.execution_result composes these witnesses into FP.Structural.exec of the whole source.
source_execution.matrix_connection: TypedExecution.memory_result proves equality with ProgramModel.result, an independent matrix-load/store normal form that does not call exec. ProgramCorrespondence.source_program connects that matrix result to the independently scheduled pair model.
source_execution.load_before_store: Both split output expressions use the pre-store loaded operands. Matrix scatter and pair noninterference preserve inplace semantics.
source_execution.whole_grid: TypedGrid.execute invokes the complete source for every program. complete_list composes source successes, metadata preservation, matrix correspondence and tagged-memory frames. complete and complete_order prove complete coverage and all program permutations.
source_execution.empty_calls: total=0 or half=0 returns the initial kernel state without launching. The ordinary initial suffix invariant covers nonrotary outputs when half=0.

independent_results.real: realFormula is a coordinate formula over initial X/cos/sin values, rotary pairing, conjugation and fallback coefficients. It does not invoke source execution, ProgramModel.result or sourcePair. KernelEndpoints.real proves every logical output coordinate and the complete tagged-memory frame.
independent_results.native: nativeFormula directly spells the selected raw-word PTX graph over initial words and four scalar callbacks. It does not invoke execution, Native.ops, Native.graph or pairWord. Native.source_graph_lowering and native_pair_formula derive its equality to the executed provenance interpretation.
independent_results.all_logical_coordinates: every_token and interval coverage include fixed and packed layouts, cumulative lengths with empty intervals, every head, both rotary halves and the suffix.
independent_results.suffix: TailReady states only the existing nonrotary suffix-copy kernel-entry invariant. It is reflexive for inplace calls. No rotary output equality is assumed.
independent_results.frame: Outside quantifies all region names and offsets not written by active rotary pairs. The result preserves complete tagged Cells there, including metadata, coefficient roles, nonrotary suffix and other memory.
independent_results.native_fallback: cos=1/sin=0 fallback still runs the selected arithmetic. No all-word identity simplification is assumed.

Tensor_and_memory_connection.assessment: The unused binding and pointer arguments are not an output oracle and do not make the input-memory connection vacuous. The endpoints directly define both source input state and reference inputs from the supplied Tensor data pointers and heap.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.Tensor_interface: KernelTensor.Tensor is VeriTile.Torch.TensorMetadata, the core API-observation record. Binding relates the real input-role metadata and pointers to the checked descriptors. This interface does not claim a new allocator, output-object implementation or returned-Tensor proof.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.actual_bytes: KernelTensor.word decodes four little-endian bytes at tensor.dataPtr + 4*i. KernelTensor.bytes supplies role views of that same heap. load_pointer proves the byte-view load equals the actual pointer-based word.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.source_initial_memory: KernelTensor.lift installs those pointer-based payload words into x/out/cos/sin source cells. Initial out cells also come from its pointer, including the ordinary suffix-copy state; no result formula is written into the initial state.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.original_signed_metadata: Cumulative and offset values are loaded from the actual original Tensor pointers with their original int32 or int64 width. lift_metadata derives the signed input facts needed by source execution from Checked.check and its bounds.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.reference_input_memory: inputMemory uses the same pointer-based initial words, independently of execution. real_formula_input and native_formula_input connect it to the exact initial source memory.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.logical_read_interface: ReadLaw is an ordinary input-only interpretation law relating a logical input view to pointer-decoded words. logical_read transfers it to source cells. The raw-word public native endpoint directly uses id and does not require a supplied output-value relation.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.address_interface: Canonical launch indexing yields Shape.address(token,head,col)=(token*heads+head)*width+col and coefficient offsets (row+shift)*half+pair. Signed-formed index lemmas and KernelIndex data/coefficient pointer lemmas expose equality with nonwrapping uint64 pointer arithmetic.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.why_binding_unused: Tagged source execution and its output formula are valid for arbitrary pointer-fed input words; descriptor alignment, layout and separation facts are relevant context for the runtime representation, not needed for the algebraic tagged-memory conclusion.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.why_pointers_unused: The source interpreter indexes tagged cells with mathematical offsets. Pointer representability is proved by separately exposed KernelIndex lemmas under pointerCheck, rather than consumed by the tagged-memory execution theorem.
Tensor_and_memory_connection.output_scope: The final output values and frame are proved for the executed tagged memory. This delivery does not claim a reconstructed final physical byte heap, an actual returned Tensor object, or a physical whole-backing frame.

guards_and_domain.scope: Static comparison shows the unchanged Python checks supply the shape, signed metadata and index facts required by the kernel model. The Lean check is a sufficient abstraction for this kernel theorem, not a separately proved exact Boolean iff for every Python rejection.
guards_and_domain.admitted_behavior: FP32 ordinary contiguous CUDA payloads, canonical launch strides, zero storage offsets and no lazy flags; positive heads, 0<D<=256, rotary width<=D; fixed/packed sequences; scalar/tensor offsets; both signed metadata widths; split/interleaved, conjugate and inplace/out-of-place flags.
guards_and_domain.shape_and_metadata: Packed endpoints and monotonic cumulative values determine the exact covered token intervals. Nonnegative offsets and retained bounds justify the signed interpretation of original metadata. No configuration or final-result oracle is supplied.
guards_and_domain.bounds: Retained data, coefficient, maximum, batch and padded-address envelopes provide signed32 formation bounds. Existing pointer checks bound uint64 formation even for masked coefficient accesses; empty calls skip unused launch pointers.
guards_and_domain.unchanged_physical_separation: Python checks physically separate nonempty input backing spans. Checked descriptors model the same read-side span policy; this review adds no allocator or output-separation acceptance condition.
abstract_precondition_limits: tensorCheck allows an empty x descriptor without requiring its canonical stride list, while Python checks canonical payload strides before the early return. The kernel model is therefore weaker only for this no-launch case.
Per-batch offset maxima are vacuous when batches=0, whereas Python still checks its global max/default bound. No source program or logical token is executed in this case.
pointerCheck exposes overflow conditions; it does not encode Python's extra nonempty-output four-byte alignment rejection. No final physical-store theorem is claimed by this endpoint.
guards_and_domain.effect_of_limits: These are weakenings of the abstract kernel premises, not new restrictions on Python-admitted calls or hidden numerical assumptions. No exact guard-equivalence claim is used for acceptance.

numerical_classification.compiler_model_boundary: The fixed default coefficient-first operand/FMA selection is an explicit compiler model, supported by the 16 frozen Triton 3.7.1 SM80 profiles. It is not a universal compiler-correctness theorem.
numerical_classification.conjugation: sub.f32(+0, sin), distinct from rounded-product neg.f32
numerical_classification.historical_obligations: Native.Obligations and older numerical/host wrappers remain historical definitions. The public endpoints quantify one Instructions model and do not consume those deferred-equation structures.
numerical_classification.suffix_entry_invariant_classification: Ordinary kernel-entry memory invariant, not a numerical transformation obligation.

frozen_evidence.static_PTX_graph_check: Read-only symbolic tracing of loads identified by retained source locations, scalar operations and interleaved parity selection. All 16 artifact graphs match the selected formula with exact operand order.

Complete source success, independent Real/native results, actual pointer-fed input memory, original signed metadata, all logical coordinates and tagged-memory frame are substantively connected. Four primitive callbacks and the fixed compiler graph are model boundaries, not deferred numerical experiments.
